column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_story.prx (runtime base 0x08e9aa00, shared slot: registry ids carry the
# rel_story: prefix, addresses here do not); same columns as re/documented.tsv.

column3: summary

Recomputes the calendar block from its slot counter t (+0x00): slot +0x04 = (t-1)%7+1, day +0x10 = (t-1)/7, day number +0x0c = day+1, light period +0x14 from the table rel_story +0x208ec, weekday +0x1c = (day%7+1)%7. Never writes +0x08, +0x18, +0x20. Callers: world_advance_time_slot, world_advance_time_slots, world_set_time_slot, world_advance_to_next_day.
Calendar t += 1, then world_update_calendar. Caller: world_change_time (mode 2).
Calendar t += 7 - (t-1)%7 (slot 1 of the next day), then world_update_calendar. Caller: world_change_time (modes 5 and 6).
Returns the calendar weekday +0x1c (0 Sunday, 1 Monday). No side effects. Callers: world_change_time, 0x08eab474, 0x08ea2ef0.
Compares the calendar day index +0x10 with the last seen day at field save block +0x04; when they differ stores the new day there and returns 1, else returns 0. Caller: world_change_time.

Mode 2 +1 slot, 3 +n slots, 4 slot n of the day, 5 next day, 6 location 14 and next day, 7 slot 4; other modes only refresh. On a new day (world_check_new_day): system flag 1 cleared, world_pick_sandwich_seller, world_assign_daily_spots on Mondays (world_get_weekday == 1), daily randoms, story flags 1-20 cleared. Always ends with world_update_npc_positions. Callers: 13 sites (story init 0x08e9f3ac, island map, exits, the event driver, PDA time menu).

Sets system flag 4 to 1 when partner is 27, to 0 when partner is 26, otherwise at random (rand & 1); the flag picks which seller (26/27) sells sandwiches. Callers: world_change_time (each new day), 0x08e9b5d8.

Weekly NPC pairing: groups the 140 runtime characters (fixed ones excluded) by category, shuffles, mixes category 2 with 0/1, writes those with record flags 1 and 5 clear to the field save block +0x1c (140 bytes, 0xff = end) and clears their flag 2; with an odd count character 100 gets flag 2 and is dropped; each pair gets random flags 6-8 and two neighbouring free spots (s-1, s) of the spot table (record +0x18); then per-character randoms and one save bit. Caller: world_change_time.

For each of the 140 runtime records (0x5c bytes): character 51 flag 1 from slot 3 on; flag 3 (absent) in slots 3-4 unless flag 6; location +0x00, cell +0x0c/+0x10 and direction +0x15 from world_get_fixed_npc_spot or the spot +0x18; +0x58 = current day index; byte +0x16 = 6 when flag 8; then 0x08e9e340. The flag world_change_time passes in a0 is not read. Caller: world_change_time.

Adds delta to the character's friendship points (save_get/set/add_char_points), clamped to 0 and to world_get_points_cap() (0xffff on overflow); calls 0x08eaa6bc(delta) when the value changes. Returns 1 (raised), -1 (lowered) or 0 (already at the cap). Caller: world_change_partner_points_shown (story opcodes 50084/50085).

Gift of the current item to the partner: taste = character table[partner][world_item_taste_column(item)], random 1-5 for taste 6 or item 48, clamped to 1-5; queues the partner's reaction (character table column variant+1, 6, taste) and (301, 6, taste), or (301, 6, 6) for item 50; also calls 0x08ea5884(item). The points change comes from the queued records. Caller: world_driver_handle_result.
Opcode 50105: world_change_time(4, a1), jump to slot a1 of the day. Side effects: calendar, NPC positions (see world_change_time). Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.

Opcode 50118: field request 26 with dialogue_map_hud_marker(a1) (1 -> -1 off, 3-7 -> 1-5), waiting until the field module polls done. Side effects: field HUD marker. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50137: VM word +0xc = 1; world_driver_finish_partner_story acts on it after the script returns. Side effects: VM state. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50148: field state byte +0x65 += 1; at 5 or more sets system flag 24 (consumed by world_driver_next_event). Side effects: field state, system flags. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50149: sets system flag 25 (consumed by world_driver_next_event). Side effects: system flags. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.

Opcode 50156 and before a track change: when a track is current, fade (0x0884192c(1500)), stop (0x088418f8) and release (0x08841850) it, waiting with system_wait_frame between the steps; current track = -1. Side effects: sound state, blocks for several frames. Callers: 0x08ea2cdc, 0x08eaa76c (the track change of the bgm opcode).
Opcode 50162 (set-up pass): world_set_event_deck(a1, a2), the deck-recipe index the character uses during the event. Side effects: runtime record +0x42. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.
Opcode 50170 (set-up pass): world_set_event_remark(a1, a2), the remark index the field shows for the character during the event. Side effects: runtime record +0x3f. Caller: dialogue_run_event_script.

Sets (on != 0) or clears bit flag-1 of one of four u32 flag words: 1-32 field save block +0x14, 33-64 +0x18, 65-96 and 97-128 in the block at *(0x08ecea6c) +0x8/+0xc; other values are ignored. Side effects: story flags. 28 callers, including world_change_time, world_op_buy_sandwich, dialogue_op_series_win.
